methodologyNotes: 13 notable bed-in-a-box / direct-to-consumer mattresses selected as the 2026 buyer comparison set, covering the price spectrum from ~$695 to ~$2,499 queen MSRP and all major construction types (innerspring, all-foam, hybrid, latex hybrid). Seeds from the brief were verified and expanded: Saatva Classic confirmed (saatva.com); Purple split into Purple (Original) and Purple Restore as they are distinct positioned products; Nectar Premier confirmed via nectarsleep.com/premier-mattress/; DreamCloud confirmed as DreamCloud Classic Hybrid (dreamcloudsleep.com); Helix Midnight confirmed as the standard (non-Luxe) tier; TEMPUR-Adapt confirmed via mattressclarity.com as the entry-level Tempur-Pedic all-foam; Casper Dream confirmed (casper.com/mattresses/); Leesa Original confirmed (leesa.com); Tuft & Needle Original confirmed (tuftandneedle.com); WinkBed confirmed via mattressclarity.com and sleepfoundation.org; Brooklyn Bedding Signature Hybrid confirmed (brooklynbedding.com); Avocado Green confirmed via sleepadvisor.org. Primary sources: manufacturer product pages fetched directly where accessible. Fallbacks used for Helix Midnight, TEMPUR-Adapt, WinkBed, Purple, Avocado Green: mattressclarity.com, mattressclarity.com, sleepfoundation.org/winkbed-review, mattressclarity.com/purple, sleepadvisor.org/avocado. priceUsd = US queen MSRP / starting price (before sale) unless noted. Purple Restore MSRP from purple.com confirmed at $2,699 (on sale at $2,399); used MSRP $2,699. Purple Original MSRP $1,499 from mattressclarity.com. Brooklyn Bedding regular price $959 (confirmed from brooklynbedding.com product page). Leesa regular price $1,332 (leesa.com shows 25% off from $1,332). accessedAt 2026-06-15 on all entries. specKeys chosen for real comparability across mattress types: type (string: innerspring | foam | hybrid | latex-hybrid), firmness (string: the marketed firmness option(s), e.g. 'medium-firm' or 'soft/medium/firm'), height_in (numeric, inches for the standard/base model), cooling (string: primary cooling technology or 'passive-airflow' for coil-only, 'none' for standard foam), trial_nights (numeric), warranty_years (numeric or null for lifetime — documented separately in priceNote/provenance), lifetime_warranty (boolean), made_in_usa (boolean or null if unconfirmed), certifications (string: notable third-party certs or null), release (YYYY-MM or YYYY or null).

products.name: Saatva Classic
products.priceNote: US MSRP $2,229 for queen (standard 11.5" height), from saatva.com product page. Frequently promoted at ~$1,895. 14.5" pillow-top version is the same price. Includes white-glove delivery.
products.provenance: saatva.com product page fetched directly: confirms dual-coil innerspring construction, 3 firmness options (Plush Soft / Luxury Firm / Firm), two height options (11.5" and 14.5"), organic cotton cover, 365-night trial, lifetime warranty, white-glove delivery, US assembly. Queen MSRP $2,229. Corroboration via mattressclarity.com review which matches all specs.

products.name: Purple Mattress (Original)
products.priceNote: US queen MSRP $1,499 per mattressclarity.com review (confirmed queen price). Purple.com shows dynamic pricing; $1,299 on sale is common. MSRP $1,499 used.
products.provenance: purple.com product page fetched: confirms GelFlex Grid technology, medium-firm feel, open-air columns for cooling, 100-night trial, 10-year warranty. Height 9.25" confirmed on mattressclarity.com review (also listed as 9.5" in some sources; 9.25" is manufacturer spec from purple.com). Queen price from mattressclarity.com ($1,499 full MSRP). Made in USA status not confirmed in fetched content. Firmness rated 6.5-7/10 on mattressclarity scale.

products.name: Purple Restore
products.priceNote: US queen MSRP $2,699 per purple.com (on-sale price shown as $2,399 at time of access). The Restore is the hybrid successor to the Purple Hybrid Premier line. MSRP $2,699 used.

specs.cooling: GelFlex-Grid + coil-airflow (sleeps up to 2x cooler per brand)

products.provenance: purple.com/mattresses/restore fetched directly: confirms hybrid construction with 2" GelFlex Grid + individually-wrapped coils, 11.5" profile height, 100-night trial, 10-year warranty, coils provide increased airflow. MSRP $2,699 from purple.com (on sale $2,399 at time of access). mattressclarity.com review confirms hybrid type, 13" for RestorePlus variant (the standard Restore is 11.5"). Made in USA not specified. Release 2023 per brand launch announcements.

products.name: Nectar Premier
products.priceNote: US queen starting price $999 per nectarsleep.com/premier-mattress/ (accessed directly). Brand frequently runs promotions; $999 is the promoted queen price confirmed at time of access.

specs.cooling: cooling-fiber-cover + gel-foam-layers (60% more cooling fibers than Classic per brand)

products.provenance: nectarsleep.com/premier-mattress/ fetched directly: confirms memory foam construction, medium-firm feel, 13" height, 365-night home trial, Forever Warranty (lifetime), cool-to-touch cover with improved airflow, 60% more cooling fibers than Classic. Queen price $999. Made in USA not specified. mattressclarity.com confirms Nectar lineup hierarchy; Premier sits between Classic (12") and Luxe (14").

products.name: DreamCloud Classic Hybrid
products.priceNote: US queen starting price $699 per dreamcloudsleep.com product page (accessed directly). Brand formerly priced much higher (~$1,799); repositioned as value hybrid. $699 is the confirmed current queen price.
products.provenance: dreamcloudsleep.com/mattress/ fetched directly: confirms hybrid (foam + innerspring), firm feel, 12" height, CloudQuilt quilted cover with cooling fiber, precision-stitched channels that dissipate heat, 365-night trial, Forever Warranty (lifetime), $699 queen. Made in USA not confirmed. reviewed.com confirms DreamCloud Hybrid as a notable value-tier recommendation. Release year 2018 per original brand launch; current spec/pricing reflects 2022+ repositioning.

products.name: Helix Midnight
products.priceNote: US queen MSRP $1,332 per mattressclarity.com review (confirmed as queen starting price for the standard non-Luxe Helix Midnight). helixsleep.com blocks direct fetch. Helix frequently promotes at ~30% off.

specs.cooling: breathable-cover + coil-airflow (memory-foam-layer; no active phase-change standard)

products.provenance: mattressclarity.com/reviews/helix-sleep/ fetched directly: confirms standard Helix Midnight is a hybrid (foam comfort layers + pocketed coil support), 12" height, medium-firm 6.5/10, Memory Plus Foam comfort layer, 120-night trial, Limited Lifetime Warranty, queen price $1,332. helixsleep.com returned 403 for all direct product URLs. reviewed.com best-mattresses roundup confirms Helix Midnight as a top pick at $936–$1,748 range. Made in USA assembly confirmed by sleepjunkie.com (Midnight Luxe sourced to Arizona) but not independently verified for base Midnight model. Release year approximate.

products.name: TEMPUR-Adapt
products.priceNote: US queen full MSRP $2,499 per mattressclarity.com review (confirmed as queen price). tempurpedic.com serves JavaScript-only content and could not be directly fetched. TEMPUR-Adapt is Tempur-Pedic's entry all-foam model; Medium Hybrid variant is higher. Price reflects all-foam Medium model.
products.provenance: mattressclarity.com review fetched directly: confirms all-foam (and hybrid variant), medium firmness 6.5/10, 11" height, cool-to-touch cover with premium knit, hybrid version includes 1,000+ spring coils, 90-night trial, 10-year limited warranty, queen price $2,499. tempurpedic.com returns empty content (JavaScript-rendered, not fetchable). bobvila.com confirms Tempur-Pedic ProAdapt all-foam at 12" (different tier); TEMPUR-Adapt at 11" confirmed via mattressclarity. Made in USA not confirmed from available fetched sources. Release 2019 per Tempur-Pedic product history.

products.name: Casper Dream
products.priceNote: US queen starting price $1,620 per casper.com/mattresses/ (accessed directly). Casper Dream is a mid-tier hybrid; the optional QuickCool cover upgrade brings the queen to ~$1,770 (separate Casper Snow product is higher). $1,620 is the standard Dream queen price.

specs.cooling: passive-airflow (QuickCool cover upgrade available at extra cost)

products.provenance: casper.com/mattresses/ fetched directly: confirms Casper Dream is a hybrid, medium, 12", designed and assembled in America, 100-night risk-free trial, 10-year limited warranty, queen $1,620. QuickCool cover is an optional upgrade (Dream with QuickCool has specialty cool-to-touch fibers). Made in USA confirmed: 'designed and assembled in America'. Release year 2023 per Casper's lineup refresh.

products.name: Leesa Original
products.priceNote: US queen regular/MSRP price $1,332 per leesa.com (product page shows 25% off from $1,332, confirming $1,332 as the reference MSRP). On-sale queen price $999 at time of access.
products.provenance: leesa.com/products/leesa-mattress fetched directly: confirms all-foam (memory foam) construction, medium firmness (76% of customers reported medium feel), 10" height, breathable responsive foam top layer, 120-night trial, limited lifetime warranty, made in Arizona (designed and assembled in Arizona), queen regular price $1,332 (25% off shown as $999). Release year 2014 per Leesa founding and original product launch.

products.name: Tuft & Needle Original
products.priceNote: US queen MSRP $695 per tuftandneedle.com product page (accessed directly). One of the most affordable quality foam mattresses in the comparison set.
products.provenance: tuftandneedle.com/mattresses/original-mattress fetched directly: confirms all-foam (T&N Adaptive foam + T&N Flex foam), medium-firm, 10" height, breathable cover with cooling technology, T&N Adaptive foam provides up to 7% better airflow than standard memory foam, 100-night sleep trial, 10-year limited warranty, assembled in USA, queen $695. T&N is a Serta Simmons subsidiary; GREENGUARD Gold certification confirmed on product page. Release year 2012 per brand founding.

products.name: WinkBed
products.priceNote: US queen MSRP $1,799 per mattressclarity.com review. winkbeds.com direct product URL returned 404 (path variations blocked). $1,799 confirmed as the queen starting price (Softer/Medium/Firmer; Plus is higher).
products.provenance: mattressclarity.com/reviews/winkbed/ fetched: confirms hybrid (often classified as innerspring-feel), 4 firmness levels (Softer ~4, Medium ~6, Firmer ~7, Plus/firmer for heavier sleepers), 14" height, Tencel cover, gel-infused polyfoam in pillow-top, 120-night trial, lifetime warranty, queen $1,799. sleepfoundation.org review (via direct fetch) confirms 13.5" height (slight measurement difference by reviewer vs 14" manufacturer spec; 14" is brand-stated). winkbeds.com homepage confirms 'handmade in the U.S.A.' with American-sourced materials, Extra-Edge support system, Wirecutter #1 innerspring 2020-2026. winkbeds.com direct product page 404'd; using confirmed aggregator data.

products.name: Brooklyn Bedding Signature Hybrid
products.priceNote: US queen MSRP $959 per brooklynbedding.com product page (accessed directly; sale price shown as $719.25 at time of access). $959 is the stated regular/reference price.
products.provenance: brooklynbedding.com/products/brooklyn-signature-hybrid fetched directly: confirms hybrid (foam + coil), 3 firmness options (Soft/Medium/Firm), 12.25" height, ThermoPhase foam with phase change material, GlacioTex cooling cover, 120-night trial, Limited Lifetime Warranty, designed and assembled in Arizona (USA), queen MSRP $959 (sale $719.25 at time of access). Optional Cloud Pillow Top upgrade available.

products.name: Avocado Green Mattress
products.priceNote: US queen starting price $1,999 per sleepadvisor.org review (before discounts). avocadogreenmattress.com product pages returned 404; brand site confirms up to 365-night trial and up to 25-year warranty. $1,999 is the standard (no pillow top) queen price.

specs.certifications: GOLS + GOTS + GREENGUARD Gold + OEKO-TEX + MADE SAFE

products.provenance: sleepadvisor.org/avocado-green-mattress-review/ fetched directly: confirms hybrid latex/innerspring construction, standard model is 7/10 firmness (firm), pillow top is 6/10 (medium-firm), 11" height for standard model, aerated Dunlop latex top layer, organic cotton cover, 365-night trial, 25-year limited warranty, queen starting price $1,999. Certifications confirmed: GOLS, GOTS, GREENGUARD Gold, OEKO-TEX, MADE SAFE. avocadogreenmattress.com/collections/mattresses fetched: confirms handmade in Fullerton California, organic wool, organic latex, EWG Verified. Product page /green-mattress returned 404 but collections page and brand homepage confirmed USA manufacturing and certification suite.
